guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Keep an ally and a retreat corner in view. Avoid angles where only the enemy can reach you.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Save Sleep Dart when a diver is approaching. Use Biotic Grenade when your team can act on the healing denial.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Coordinate Nano Boost before the fight. Track cleansing and defensive abilities before committing your grenade.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

matchups.explanation: Use vertical mobility to contest Pharah and intercept eligible projectiles with Matrix; avoid leaving your backline exposed.
Use vertical access and a barrier to disrupt a sniper position. Confirm support and an exit before diving.
Healing denial can pressure Roadhog, but cleansing and cover can prevent follow-up. Keep your distance from the hook.
Particle beam pressure bypasses Defense Matrix. Mech mobility can still avoid your effective range.
Tesla pressure cannot be solved by Deflect. Keep distance and an escape route rather than dueling at close range.
Matrix does not stop the particle beam. Contest other angles and avoid a prolonged close-range duel.
Resurrection exposes you to sightlines. Use cover and check the sniper angle before committing.
Vertical pressure is difficult to reach directly. Use cover and ask ranged allies to contest her.
Suzu can answer healing denial or sleep on an ally, but timing and resource availability matter.
